description: This file defines a security policy module for the host environment, specifically listing environment variable keys that are blocked or overridden for security or restriction purposes in Swift. It contains static sets of environment variable names that are disallowed or overridden, categorized for specific purposes.

classes.name: HostEnvSecurityPolicy
classes.description: A namespace holder for static sets of environment variables that are blocked or overridden in the host environment for security reasons.

methods.name: blockedKeys
methods.description: A set of environment variable keys that are explicitly blocked.

methods.name: blockedOverrideKeys
methods.description: A set of environment variable keys whose overrides are blocked.

methods.name: blockedOverridePrefixes
methods.description: Prefixes of environment variable keys that are blocked from override.

methods.name: blockedPrefixes
methods.description: Prefixes of environment variable keys that are entirely blocked.
